backend/main.mo: Implements user profile and product management with admin-only creation and default population, using access control and map-based storage.
feature_evidence.json: Describes feature evidence mapping features to code files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend files for reference or documentation.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based theme variables for light and dark modes and applies global styling.
frontend/index.html: Loads jsPDF and JSZip from CDNs and mounts the React app root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication state, profile setup, onboarding, navigation between editor/export/preview/storefront views.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with error handling and dynamic aria labels.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for capturing and saving a new user's name before using the workspace.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: React error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays a styled fallback with reload and optional dev error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Tabbed UI component providing detailed instructions for using the app and selling generated digital products.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Export interface allowing users to download generated PDFs and ZIPs individually or as a master bundle, with error handling and size formatting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Application layout with header, navigation buttons, authentication awareness, and contextual preview/export actions.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal dialog showing onboarding instructions by embedding ExportInstructions with a close action.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Displays an inline PDF preview using an iframe or an alert when no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Unified preview screen showing all products with cover images, descriptions, and PDF previews, plus back navigation.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Renders a scrollable preview of files that will be included in a product ZIP, dynamically listing templates, checklists, and prompts.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Provides a multi-tab editor UI for modifying product fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists, with generation trigger support.
Manages multiple products, draft persistence, validation, and generation actions, including backend population and error handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover, truncated description, and an edit button, supporting expand/collapse for long text.
Shows a storefront-style grid of default products with a header and back button, enabling navigation to product editing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and maintains an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication state, login/logout handling, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Handles onboarding modal visibility and persistence using localStorage, with auto-open logic.
frontend/src/hooks/usePopulateDefaultPro: Provides hooks to check admin status and trigger backend default product population, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks to load and save the current user profile via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and custom utility styles.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Provides product cover image paths and utilities to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Defines default product entries with metadata, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utilities to trigger browser downloads for blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-based filenames for product PDFs and ZIPs.
frontend/src/lib/generation/formatGenera: Formats generation errors into user-friendly messages and logs full error details.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Sequentially generates bundles for all products and reports progress.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Generates a product's cover, PDF, and ZIP bundle with structured error handling.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generationEr: Defines typed generation error classes and metadata for debugging failures.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages saving, loading, and resetting draft product data in localStorage with versioning.
Builds a product PDF using jsPDF, validating fields and rendering cover, text, and sections.
frontend/src/lib/pdf/jspdfClient.ts: Provides a safe wrapper for accessing jsPDF from the browser-loaded CDN.
frontend/src/lib/validation/productValid: Provides product field validation and aggregates missing required fields across all products.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Generates a master ZIP containing individual product ZIPs and a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP for a single product including PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and a README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/jszipClient.ts: Wraps JSZip loaded from the CDN and offers helper functions to create ZIP instances with error handling.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates README sections for product usage and marketplace upload instructions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript types for products, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, layout settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata including features, issues, and state version for Digital Bundle Studio.
